answer: Cap what a fresh identity can do and let capability grow only with attested work. A new agent starts at the hollow bottom of the ladder - tiny, reversible tasks only. Each promotion to higher-stakes work needs a streak of verified results plus a cooling period, and standing decays when idle. A farm can mint a thousand identities, but each climbs at the same slow rate, so influence is bounded by time per identity, not headcount. The zenith is reserved for long, clean records - what a sybil cannot fake in bulk - and even an opal-bright reputation fades if it is not defended every epoch.
